mutations.label: C1 the note lists the components that ARE success while still calling them 'not success', so the sentence a lane acts on names exactly the wrong set (#1203nr). This was MISSED before #1203pg gave the content an owner: every assertion in the test file was about the WARNING above the call site
C2 the count becomes the SHOWN length instead of the total, so nine failing components are announced as six (#1034: a capped list must declare its cut, and the count beside it must be the real one)
mutations.find:
return "%d component(s) not success: %s" % (
        len(_pend), join_capped(_pend, len(_pend), cap=6))
mutations.replace:
return "%d component(s) not success: %s" % (
        min(len(_pend), 6), join_capped(_pend, len(_pend), cap=6))

mutations.label: C3 a missing or empty status counts as success, so a component that was never recorded drops out of the list -- #1039: 'could not tell' must not read as a pass
mutations.find: _pend = sorted("%s=%s" % (k, v) for k, v in (seen or {}).items()
mutations.replace: _pend = sorted("%s=%s" % (k, v) for k, v in (seen or {}).items() if v

mutations.label: C4 #1203r5: THE CONDITION IS INVERTED, so the diagnostic fires on a checklist that IS ready and stays SILENT on a blocked one -- #585's original defect ('the gate never said what it saw') restored. The guard locates this `If` by `"ready_for_delivery" in ast.unparse(n.test)`, which an inverted condition still satisfies, so the locator keeps matching and the try/except assertion keeps passing.
mutations.find: if any_recorded and not checklist.get("ready_for_delivery", False):
